scope: Five actual image-to-video scenes: two generated using Gemini and three using Google Flow. No animated-still substitutes presented as generated videos.
provider: Gemini web UI (Hero and Nature); Google Flow web UI (Featured, Philosophy and Temple)
backend_model: Not independently verified; observed UI labels are not a backend-version claim.

scenes.processing: Silent H.264 faststart, 24 fps, source color tags retained. Desktop 1920x1080 CRF20; mobile 1280x720 CRF19. Accepted five-second circular loop phase retained: source frames106-219 followed by six frames blending source220-225 with100-105 at head weights0,1/6,2/6,3/6,4/6,5/6. No reverse motion, motion interpolation or new generation. WebP posters use encoded loop frame12 (0.5 seconds), chosen so the foreground petal does not cover the right swan eye.
scenes.quality: Independent equal-scale encode and mobile-cover comparisons selected CRF20 desktop and 720p mobile to retain visible upscale detail. Dense five-second chronology and seam frames show no black-frame interval or new gross morphing. Brief doubled swan contours/petals remain during the inherited 0.25-second overlap; not claimed ghost-free/perfectly seamless. Continuous normal-speed perception remains unverified.
scenes.upscale: User-supplied 1080p upscale of the accepted original. Upscale provider/model not independently verified; added apparent texture is not claimed recovered factual detail.

scenes.processing: Silent H.264 faststart, 24 fps, no color grade. Desktop 1920x1080 CRF24; mobile 1280x720 CRF23. Source segment 2.50–7.75s with 0.25-second circular overlap gives 5.00s output. No reverse motion or frame interpolation. WebP posters use output 0.5s.
scenes.upscale: Google Flow download option labeled 1080p Upscaled. Apparent detail is enhanced; it is not claimed recovered factual detail. Upscale backend not independently verified.
scenes.quality: Full-duration source and upscale frame reviews accepted stable architecture, camera and anatomy. Dense loop seam review completed; short overlap may visibly soften moving petals/reflections and briefly double swan contours. No black fade. Not claimed perfectly seamless; normal-speed page-context perception remains to be checked.
